messages.message: Here you can see active events that require a manager decision. Some decisions take effect immediately, while others remain active until expiry.
There are currently no open club events.
This response remains active until the event expires.
This event has already been completed.
A response has already been selected for this event.
{playername} appears increasingly unhappy. The situation may affect his satisfaction and the mood at the club.
Costs some money for a clarifying conversation and support, but increases his satisfaction.
No direct costs, but satisfaction falls and the board is slightly irritated.
The player is placed on the transfer market. His satisfaction falls slightly.
Your sponsor {sponsorname} is facing public criticism. The club must decide how to respond.
Costs money, but protects fan and board satisfaction.
Provides short-term income, but harms relations with fans and the board.
No direct costs, but the fans and board react negatively.
A local scout recommends {youthplayer}, aged {youth_age}, position {youth_position}. The player could join your youth team.
The player joins your youth team. A small training compensation fee is charged.
Damage has been found at {teamname}’s stadium. You can repair it immediately or risk lower attendance.
High repair costs, but no further restrictions.
No immediate cost, but attendance falls until the event expires.
If no action is taken in time, an expensive emergency repair will be required and the board will be dissatisfied.
%s has reacted to a club event.
